formulas.total_costs_and_expenses: purchased_commodities + production_and_operating_expenses + sga + exploration_expenses + depreciation_depletion_amortization + impairments + taxes_other_than_income_taxes + accretion_on_discounted_liabilities + interest_and_debt_expense + foreign_currency_transaction_loss + other_expenses

total_revenues_yoy.description: Total revenues and other income YoY growth rate vs Q-4

purchased_commodities_margin_delta_bps.description: Purchased commodities as % of total revenues, basis point change vs Q-4

production_and_operating_expenses_margin.description: Production and operating expenses as % of total revenues, basis point change vs Q-4

depreciation_depletion_amortization_yoy.description: DD&A expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

sga_yoy.description: SG&A expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

exploration_expenses_yoy.description: exploration_expenses YoY growth rate vs Q-4

impairments_abs.description: impairments absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

taxes_other_than_income_taxes_yoy.description: taxes_other_than_income_taxes YoY growth rate vs Q-4

accretion_on_discounted_liabilities_abs.description: accretion_on_discounted_liabilities absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

interest_and_debt_expense_yoy.description: interest_and_debt_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

foreign_currency_transaction_loss_abs.description: foreign_currency_transaction_loss absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

other_expenses_abs.description: other_expenses absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).
